_meta.indication: WINREVAIR is indicated for the treatment of adults with pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH, WHO Group 1) to increase exercise capacity, improve WHO functional class (FC), and reduce the risk of clinical worsening events.

pivotal_trials.design: Phase 3, multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-assignment trial (randomized 1:1); 24-week double-blind placebo-controlled period followed by long-term double-blind period up to 72 weeks; 126 centers in 21 countries.
pivotal_trials.population: Adults with PAH (WHO Group 1, WHO FC II or III), baseline PVR ≥4 Wood units by RHC, 6MWD of ≥100 and ≤550 meters, on stable double or triple background PAH therapies.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Primary efficacy endpoint: treatment difference in change from baseline in 6-minute walk distance (6MWD) at Week 24.
pivotal_trials.result: Median treatment difference (Hodges-Lehmann location shift) in 6MWD at Week 24 was 40.8 meters (p<0.001) favoring sotatercept. Secondary endpoints also favored sotatercept: PVR treatment difference -234.6 dynes*sec/cm5 (p<0.001) and NT-proBNP -441.6 pg/mL (p<0.001).

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (≥10% and ≥5% more than placebo) were headache (24.5% vs 17.5%), epistaxis (22.1% vs 1.9%), rash (20.2% vs 8.1%), telangiectasia (16.6% vs 4.4%), diarrhea (15.3% vs 10.0%), dizziness (14.7% vs 6.2%), and erythema (13.5% vs 3.1%). Key risks include erythrocytosis, severe thrombocytopenia (platelet count <50,000/mm3 in 3% of patients), serious bleeding, and embryo-fetal toxicity.
target_moa: Sotatercept-csrk is a recombinant homodimeric activin receptor type IIA-Fc (ActRIIA-Fc) fusion protein that acts as a circulating ligand trap, binding Activin-A and other TGF-β superfamily ligands for ActRIIA to inhibit activin signaling; it is a new pharmacologic class, an activin signaling inhibitor.

advisory_committee.vote: No Advisory Committee meeting was held because no unexpected significant safety or efficacy issues or controversial issues arose that would benefit from advisory committee discussion.

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental biologics license application provides for revisions throughout labeling based on the ZENITH study, including expansion of the currently approved indication, for the treatment of adults with pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH, Group 1).

basis.text: Sotatercept received breakthrough therapy designation on April 7, 2020, based on the serious nature of PAH, the lack of any approved therapy to modify the underlying disease, and the demonstrated potential of sotatercept, based on a novel mechanism (activin signaling inhibitor).
